deployRange.note: A battalion throws out its skirmishers when formed enemy is this close.

screenDistance.note: The screen works this far in front of its battalion. Period practice was 100-300 paces.

skirmishRange.note: Skirmishers fire at a target within this distance of the screen. Aimed fire was opened at longer range than volleys.

recallGap.note: The screen is driven in when formed enemy infantry comes this close to the battalion, about 30 m from the screen itself.

cavalryRecallRange.note: The screen runs in when unblown enemy cavalry is this close to the battalion.

fireInterval.note: One aimed round per skirmisher in this time.

battlefieldFactor.note: Scales the musket trial curve for aimed skirmish fire at a formed body. Set a little above the volley factor (0.04) because the fire is aimed and deliberate.

vsSkirmishers.note: Hit chance against men in extended order relative to a formed body.

shock.note: Morale factor for casualties from skirmish fire, as frontal musketry.

redeployDelay.note: A screen that has come in does not go out again for this long. Stops screens flickering in and out at the edge of a threshold.

maxFraction.note: The most of a battalion that can be out as skirmishers; the rest stays formed as the reserve the screen falls back on.
